name: Italians Arena Fast Castle (Strategy 1: 1 TC Heavy Army Push (Genoese + Light Cav + Monks + Rams -> Imp TCs))
author: AoE2 Build Order Generator
description: Italians Arena Strategy 1 (3 Deer, No Chickens): 26+2 Fast Castle -> Defensive Castle (0s wait) -> Genoese Crossbowmen + Light Cavalry (never idling TC) + Monastery & 2 Monks (max 1 Relic assumed) -> Forward Siege Workshop & Battering Rams at 30+ army -> Stick to 1 TC until clicking Imperial Age, then add TCs & push!

notes: Vils #1-#3 @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ 2 Houses at 0:00 then @animal/Sheep_aoe2DE.png@ (5s walk). Vils #4-#6 to @animal/Sheep_aoe2DE.png@. Push 3 @animal/Deer_aoe2DE.png@ (no Chickens).
Vil #7 walks 15s + @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ @lumber_camp/Lumber_camp_aoe2de.png@ #1 -> @resource/Aoe2de_wood.png@.
Vils #8-#9 to @resource/Aoe2de_wood.png@ at @lumber_camp/Lumber_camp_aoe2de.png@ #1.
Vil #10 lures 1st @animal/Boar_aoe2DE.png@ (arrives 03:25).
Vil #11 to @resource/Aoe2de_wood.png@ at @lumber_camp/Lumber_camp_aoe2de.png@ #1 (4 on Wood).
Vil #12 @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ House #3 -> Pushed @animal/Deer_aoe2DE.png@ under TC.
Vils #13-#15 to Pushed @animal/Deer_aoe2DE.png@ under TC (4 on Deer + 7 on Boar). Lure 2nd @animal/Boar_aoe2DE.png@ at 04:43.
Vil #16 @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ @mill/Mill_aoe2de.png@ on @resource/BerryBushDE.png@ -> @resource/BerryBushDE.png@.
Vils #17-#19 to @resource/BerryBushDE.png@ (Vil #18 builds House #4 first; 4/4 on Berries).
Vil #20 to @resource/Aoe2de_wood.png@ at @lumber_camp/Lumber_camp_aoe2de.png@ #1 (5 on Wood).
Vil #21 @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ @mining_camp/Mining_camp_aoe2de.png@ on @resource/Aoe2de_stone.png@ -> @resource/Aoe2de_stone.png@.
Vils #22-#24 to @resource/Aoe2de_stone.png@ (Vil #24 builds House #5 first; 4/4 on Stone).
Vils #25-#26 to @resource/Aoe2de_wood.png@ (7 on LC #1). Click @age/FeudalAgeIconDE_alpha.png@ (425F, 0s TC idle).

In @age/FeudalAgeIconDE_alpha.png@: queue +2 @resource/MaleVillDE.jpg@s to @resource/Aoe2de_gold.png@ MC; 3 vils @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ @market/Market_aoe2DE.png@ & 1 vil @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ @blacksmith/Blacksmith_aoe2de.png@.
Sell 100 @resource/Aoe2de_stone.png@ at @market/Market_aoe2DE.png@ (+70G high Feudal price) & click @age/CastleAgeIconDE_alpha.png@ (680F, 170G).

Upon clicking @age/CastleAgeIconDE_alpha.png@: research @lumber_camp/DoubleBitAxe_aoe2DE.png@ & @mill/HorseCollar_aoe2DE.png@. Seed Farms #3-#5, Gold Mining, @lumber_camp/Lumber_camp_aoe2de.png@ #2, @barracks/Barracks_aoe2DE.png@ -> @stable/Stable_aoe2DE.png@ #1 & Fletching.

On reaching @age/CastleAgeIconDE_alpha.png@ (650+ @resource/Aoe2de_stone.png@ ready!): immediately drop Defensive @castle/Castle_aoe2DE.png@ (0s wait <= 10s max), research @lumber_camp/BowSaw_aoe2DE.png@, and keep 1 @town_center/Towncenter_aoe2DE.png@ continuous.
Start Genoese Xbows at @castle/Castle_aoe2DE.png@, then @stable/Lightcavalry_aoe2DE.png@ at @stable/Stable_aoe2DE.png@ (never idle TC; drop to 2 on @resource/Aoe2de_stone.png@).
@resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ @monastery/Monastery_aoe2DE.png@ (-175W) and train 2 Monks (assume max 1 Relic secured = +30G/min).
Get early Archer & Cav upgrades (Padded Archer, Bodkin, Scale Barding, Bloodlines, Forging); use @market/Market_aoe2DE.png@ (~50G/100 early-mid Castle) if Wood floats.
At 30+ Army: send forward @resource/MaleVillDE.jpg@ to @resource/Aoe2de_hammer.png@ Forward @siege_workshop/Siege_workshop_aoe2DE.png@ & train 3-4 @siege_workshop/Battering_ram_aoe2DE.png@s to push!

Add @university/University_aoe2DE.png@ (@university/Ballistics_aoe2DE.png@), @town_center/WheelbarrowDE.png@, Stable #2, and stick strictly to 1 @town_center/Towncenter_aoe2DE.png@ until clicking @age/ImperialAgeIconDE_alpha.png@ (use @market/Market_aoe2DE.png@ at ~30G/100 if needed).
After clicking @age/ImperialAgeIconDE_alpha.png@: add @town_center/Towncenter_aoe2DE.png@ #2 & #3 as soon as affordable!
Research @university/Chemistry_aoe2DE.png@, Conscription, Bracer, Capped Ram, Hussar, Elite Genoese, Pavise & Silk Armor + @siege_workshop/Bombard_cannon_aoe2DE.png@s!
